notes.content: [h2]We are happy to inform you that the game is finally out and now everyone can play it.[/h2][h3][/h3][h3]We invite you to dive into this unforgettable adventure with us![/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649463/71070b475d0df3bc15d6c3acc71bcd52452dfb94.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Release on June 20!
notes.content: [h1]June 20, 2025 ːsteamthumbsupː[/h1][h3]After a long wait, we want to inform you that the game is already completely ready and will be released on the appointed day![/h3][p][/p][p]There's just a little bit of patience left and everyone will be able to master the art of Pogo and compete with other players in the title of the most skilled master.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649463/bc86b0b4fa44f168786ce7d63c73ea215ad8049f.png"][/img]ːsteamthisː[/p]
